name: Rush Rally Collection
storyline:
In Rush Rally 3, dynamic 3D racing takes center stage with modern chase cams and cockpit views, combining the realism of a sim with the approachable mechanics and intuitive interface of an arcade racer. With a wealth of single-player content including its robust career mode, single race options and even metal-to-metal rally cross, Rush Rally 3 offers a wide range of events to satisfy even the hungriest drivers. Push your skills to the limit against real-time vehicle damage that impacts handling. Enjoy 60 FPS racing at night or day in the rain or snow, and explore more than 72 unique stages, each with different surface types.

In Rush Rally Origins, return to the roots of the racing genre with a remake of the series’ first entry that celebrates classic rally games in top-down style while benefitting from advancements in graphics and handling. Take on 48 stages across the world, each with the ability to change time of day and weather. Drive over snow, gravel, dirt, mud and tarmac! Advance your career in a series of single-player championships, master time trials and race at 60 FPS with one of the most carefully tuned car dynamics models to date. And if you’re feeling extra competitive, aim for the top of online leaderboards or challenge ghost cars to improve your lines!
summary: Get ready to experience the full spectrum of rally racing, from genre roots to its modern evolution! Rush Rally Collection bundles acclaimed indie racer Rush Rally 3 with the updated and definitive version of Rush Rally Origins. This special 2-in-1 release brings with it more than 15 years of racing game development experience, all focused on making Rush Rally Collection a victory lap for fans of the genre and newcomers alike!
